title: The Men’s Rebirth
description: A seven-day retreat on Hawaiʻi Island helping divorced men rebuild confidence and connection with honest feedback from women coaches.

texts.value: Seven days on Hawaiʻi Island to rebuild confidence, presence, and direction—with guided practice and honest feedback to help you feel comfortable connecting with women again.

texts.label: A deliberate pause for the man who knows the old way is no longer
texts.value: A deliberate pause for the man who knows the old way is no longer working.

texts.label: The life you had ended. Yours didn't.
texts.value: The life you had ended. Yours didn't.

texts.label: Maybe you're moving through divorce, rejection, burnout, isolatio
texts.value: Maybe you're moving through divorce, rejection, burnout, isolation, or the quiet realization that you no longer recognize yourself.

texts.label: This retreat is for men ready to participate—not perform. You do
texts.value: This retreat is for men ready to participate—not perform. You do not need to arrive with answers. You do need honesty, respect for the group, and a willingness to engage.

texts.label: Most men never get honest feedback from women. Here, you will.
texts.value: Most men never get honest feedback from women. Here, you will.

texts.label: You begin a real conversation with a woman coach. She reflects wh
texts.value: You begin a real conversation with a woman coach. She reflects what she actually experienced—your posture, voice, eye contact, pace, attention, and emotional presence. You adjust, then practice again.

texts.label: The goal is not a pickup technique. It is learning to create genu
texts.value: The goal is not a pickup technique. It is learning to create genuine connection without pretending, chasing, or shrinking.

texts.value: Open Gate is an off-grid basecamp on Hawaiʻi Island's southeastern lava fields. Accommodations are simple and communal rather than resort-style, with access to the coast, jungle, and volcanic landscapes.
